## ChatHighlight

Supporting declaration used by a public type. This is not an additional runtime API or SDK helper.

```ts
export interface ChatHighlight {
    id: string;
    sourceKind: "tutor" | "side";
    sourceId: string;
    sideMessageId?: string;
    selector: TextSelector;
    color: HighlightColor;
    createdAt: string;
}
```

**Related types:** [HighlightColor](highlights.md#highlightcolor), [TextSelector](citations.md#textselector).
